title: promise.set@1
description: A check the agent promised for later became a wake-up (#120): the quote it came from, when it is due, how many times this promise has been set, and its end. A wake-up never sets itself again; only the agent promising again does.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

promise.description: The promise's ID, the same on every event about it.

quote.description: The agent's sentence the promise was read from.

due.description: When the wake-up fires, ms since the Unix epoch.

times_set.description: How many times this promise has been set, this one included.

end.description: Past this time the promise can't be set again: a set due later is BLOCKED.
